verses.text: But now, Job, please listen to what I say. Pay attention to all my words.
Look, I am about to open my mouth. My words are on the tip of my tongue.
My words come from an honest heart. My lips will speak sincerely what I know.
The Spirit of God has made me. The breath of the Almighty gives me life.
Answer me if you can. Get your arguments ready and stand up to face me.
Look, I am just like you in God's sight. I too was made from clay.
So you do not need to be afraid of me. I will not press down hard on you.
But you have said it while I was listening. I heard your very words:
'I am pure and have done nothing wrong. I am clean and have no sin.
Yet God has found reasons to attack me. He treats me as his enemy.
He puts my feet in chains and watches every step I take.'
But I tell you, you are not right in this, because God is greater than any human.
Why do you complain to him that he does not answer people's questions?
God speaks in one way, and then in another, even though people may not notice it.
He speaks in dreams, in visions at night, when people are in a deep sleep, as they lie in their beds.
He may speak in their ears and frighten them with warnings,
to turn them away from doing wrong and keep them from pride.
He keeps them from going down to the grave, and saves their lives from being killed by the sword.
Or someone may be corrected with pain on his sickbed, with constant aching in his bones.
He cannot stand to eat. Even his favorite food disgusts him.
His body wastes away to nothing, and his bones that were hidden now stick out.
He comes close to the grave, and his life is near to those who bring death.
But if an angel is there beside him, one out of a thousand, a helper to tell him what is right,
the angel will be kind to him and say, 'Save him from going down to the grave. I have found a price to set him free.'
Then his body will become as healthy as a child's. He will be young and strong again.
He will pray to God, and God will be pleased with him. He will see God's face and shout for joy. God will make him right again.
He will sing to others, 'I sinned and twisted what was right, but I was not punished as I deserved.
God saved me from going down to the grave, and I will live to see the light.'
God does all these things for a person, again and again,
to bring him back from the grave, so that the light of life can shine on him.
Pay attention, Job, and listen to me. Be quiet, and I will speak.
If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, because I want to prove you right.
But if not, listen to me. Be quiet, and I will teach you wisdom."
